<h2 align="center">Papyra 1.1 — a journal for every day</h2>

<p align="center">
  A built-in journal, a daily update check, and a few fixes, including one security fix.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/journal-dark.png">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/journal-light.png" alt="The Papyra journal: one page for each day" width="760">
  </picture>
</p>

### 🌟 Highlights
- **A journal, built in.** One page for each day, linked to your notes and to-dos. Fold sections away, browse the year at a glance, lock private days in the Vault, and export to Markdown or PDF. [How it works](https://papyra.app/docs/journal)

### 🚀 Features
- **Update check.** Papyra checks once a day for a newer version and tells admins when one is out. It is also how I count active installs. [What is sent](https://papyra.app/docs/update-check)

### 🧭 Quick tour

**Use the journal**
1. Click **Journal** in the sidebar. Today's page opens, ready to write.
2. Pick how the day felt. Type `/` for photos, voice notes and to-dos, or `[[` to link a note or another day (`yesterday`, `last fri`).
3. Click the date to open the **calendar**, with your streak and "on this day".

<p align="center">
  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/calendar-dark.png">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/calendar-light.png" alt="The journal calendar, with a mood colour for each day" width="640">
  </picture>
</p>

4. Press **Lock** in the page footer to seal a day with your vault PIN. Locked days are listed in the **Vault**, by date only.

<p align="center">
  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/vault-dark.png">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/vault-light.png" alt="The Vault, listing a locked journal day by date" width="640">
  </picture>
</p>

5. Take it with you: **Settings → Data & Storage → Journal export** gives you Markdown files or a PDF book.

**Reorder the sidebar.** Go to **Settings → Appearance → Sidebar order** and use the arrows to put Notes, To Do and Journal in the order you like. **Reset order** puts them back. It's remembered on each device.

<p align="center">
  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/sidebar-order-dark.png">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyfie-org/papyra/v1.1.0/.github/release-notes/media/v1.1.0/sidebar-order-light.png" alt="Settings, Appearance: Sidebar order, with Journal moved to the top" width="480">
  </picture>
</p>

**Fold what you're not using.** Click a section heading, such as Pinned on the Notes page or Notes and Journal in the Vault, to fold it away. Papyra remembers which ones, per device.

**See when an update is out** (admins). A warning icon appears beside the version in the sidebar. Click it for a link to the release notes.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **New notes now work over plain HTTP.** Creating a note failed when Papyra was opened over `http://` from another device on your network, such as a Raspberry Pi at home.
- Bookmark cards and dragged blocks no longer overlap the text around them.
- In the journal, the `/` menu stays in view while you scroll, and the drag handle no longer shows.

### 🔒 Security
- **Expired shares now stop working right away.** A note shared with a person for a limited time could still be opened, edited and re-shared for up to 10 minutes after it expired. It now closes the moment it expires, and the person sees a blurred "Share expired" card they can remove. A note passed on by an editor can no longer outlast the share it came from.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Papyra now makes one outbound request a day, to `versions.papyra.app`.

### Credits
- **@PeterB2020**: [#90](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/issues/90), creating notes failed over plain HTTP. Fixed in [`45dcee0`](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/commit/45dcee06d4aa14df78d11003a3f6c34492e2d304).
- **wyx200612**: expired person shares stayed readable for up to 10 minutes. Fixed in [`a7bf7af`](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/commit/a7bf7afa27e39d6d5bc189c574a2ecdc64753ab1).

### 🙌 Want to help build Papyra?
Papyra is a small, open-source project, and there's plenty to do: bug fixes, new features, docs, translations, testing on odd setups. If you'd like to pitch in, start with the [contributing guide](https://papyra.app/contribute/) or pick something from the [open issues](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/issues). First-timers are welcome.

### ❤️ Can't contribute? You can still help
Papyra is free and always will be. If it's useful to you, [star it on GitHub](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra) or tell a friend who'd like a calm, self-hosted notes app. If you'd like to chip in towards the time and hosting it takes, you can sponsor the project:
